arabic text: Shabbir teri gurbat ki kasam mei laash teri dafana deti
english translation text: Shabbir, by your loneliness I swear, I would have buried your body

arabic text: Kausar ke tuje chinte deti zamzam se tuje nehla deti
english translation text: I would have sprinkled you with water from Kawthar and bathed you with Zamzam

english translation text: (Shabbir, this is a foreign land; otherwise, upon your funeral)\nx2 I would have heaped blossoms and showered flowers upon you

arabic text: Ay bhayi tuje maloom to hai rassi mei bandhe the haat\nmere warna mei tumhari mayat par chaadar ka kafan\npehna deti
english translation text: O brother, you know that my hands were tied in rope\nbefore me Otherwise I would have wrapped your body in my chadar\nas a shroud

arabic text: Qasim ka badan Akbar ka jigar Abbas ka baazu Awn ka\nsar ab kuch bhi nahi hai joli mei hota to tera sadka deti
english translation text: Qasim's body, Akbar's heart, Abbas's arm and Aun's head\nNothing remains in my lap; had I possessed anything, I would have offered it in charity for you
